ref.substituent_description: Piperidine with EtO on C4 (solid wedge) and an aryl on C2 (hashed bond); ring N bonded via CH2 to indole C4. The aryl has O-CH2-CH2-NHAc ortho (C2) and HO2C para (C4) to the piperidine attachment. The indole has MeO at C5, an unlabelled methyl stub at C7, and NH in the five-membered ring.
ref.notes: Typeset. Double bonds: benzene 3, indole 4 (3 in benzo ring + C2=C3). The O-to-NHAc chain has two CH2 carbons.

wrong.substituent_description: Piperidine with EtO on C4 (solid wedge) and a circled aryl on C2 (hashed bond); ring N bonded via CH2 to indole C4. The aryl has an O-CH2-CH2-CH2-NHAc chain ortho (C2) and HO2C para (C4) to the piperidine attachment. Indole (circled benzo ring, C2=C3 drawn) has MeO at C5, unlabelled methyl at C7, NH in the five-membered ring.
wrong.notes: Handwritten black ink. The O-to-NHAc zigzag has three carbon vertices (O, C, C, C, N). Only drawn double bond is indole C2=C3.

correct.substituent_description: Piperidine with EtO on C4 (solid wedge) and a circled aryl on C2 (hashed bond); ring N bonded via CH2 to indole C4. The aryl has O-CH2-CH2-NHAc ortho (C2) and HO2C para (C4) to the piperidine attachment. Indole (circled benzo ring, C2=C3 drawn) has MeO at C5, unlabelled methyl at C7, NH in the five-membered ring.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Small stray tick on the piperidine N label
correct.notes: Handwritten black ink. O-to-NHAc chain has two carbon vertices. Only drawn double bond is indole C2=C3.

errors_in_wrong.description: Reference ether side chain on the aryl ring (ortho to the piperidine attachment) is O-CH2-CH2-NHAc (two carbons); the wrong drawing has O-CH2-CH2-CH2-NHAc (three carbon vertices), adding an extra CH2.

review_notes: Wrong drawing has one extra CH2 in the O-...-NHAc chain (propyl instead of ethyl linker). Corrected drawing has the right two-carbon chain and matches the reference in everything else. Transcriber_2's ref transcription described a different molecule and was ignored.
